INDICATE.TITLE: Power ON (ACC or IG ON) Operation Description

ENTRY.PTXT: The driver enters the vehicle carrying the electronic key and presses the engine switch without depressing the brake pedal. → The main body ECU recognizes engine switch ON.
Sends a key ID code verification request to the certification ECU.
Generates request signals and sends them to the indoor antennas (front/rear)/luggage room inside antenna.
When it receives the request signal, it returns the ID code including the response code.
Receives the ID code from the electronic key and sends it to the certification ECU.
Identifies and verifies the ID code, and if inside verification is OK, sends a key verification OK response to the main body ECU.
If the power is OFF, turns the ACC relay ON; if already ACC ON, turns the IG1 and IG2 relays ON. Illuminates the indicator on the engine switch in amber.
After confirming that the power mode has changed, if the steering lock is locked, sends a steering unlock command to the main body ECU.
Receives the steering unlock command and supplies power to the steering lock motor.
After confirming through the ID code box that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, unlocks the steering. Sends unlock completion information to the certification ECU.
After confirming that the steering lock is "unlocked", sends an immobiliser unset command to the ID code box.
After confirming that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, sends an immobiliser unset command to the engine ECU.
The driver enters the vehicle carrying the electronic key and depresses the brake pedal.
→ The main body ECU recognizes stop light switch ON.
Sends a key ID code verification request to the certification ECU.
Generates request signals and sends them to the indoor antennas (front/rear)/luggage room inside antenna.
When it receives the request signal, it returns the ID code including the response code.
Receives the ID code from the electronic key and sends it to the certification ECU.
Identifies and verifies the ID code, and if inside verification is OK, sends a key verification OK response to the main body ECU.
Because the brake pedal is depressed, illuminates the indicator on the engine switch in green.
Press the engine switch. → The main body ECU recognizes engine switch ON.
After turning the ACC relay ON, turns the IG1 and IG2 relays ON.
After confirming that the power mode has changed, if the steering lock is locked, sends a steering unlock command to the main body ECU.
Receives the steering unlock command and supplies power to the steering lock motor.
After confirming through the ID code box that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, unlocks the steering. Sends unlock completion information to the certification ECU and main body ECU.
After confirming that the steering lock is "unlocked", sends an immobiliser unset command to the ID code box.
After confirming that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, sends an immobiliser unset command to the engine ECU.
After confirming that the steering lock is "unlocked", sends a start request signal to the engine ECU. After receiving the engine speed, turns off the indicator on the engine switch.

INDICATE.TITLE: Power ON (ACC or IG ON) Operation (When Electronic Key Battery Is Depleted) Description

ENTRY.PTXT: The driver enters the vehicle carrying the electronic key and depresses the brake pedal.
→ The main body ECU recognizes stop light switch ON.
Sends a key ID code verification request to the certification ECU.
Generates request signals and sends them to the indoor antennas (front/rear)/luggage room inside antenna.
Because there is no response from the electronic key, drives the immobiliser amplifier built into the engine switch.
Radio waves for immobiliser communication are output from the immobiliser amplifier.
Touch the electronic key to the front of the engine switch.
→ The electronic key receives the radio waves from the engine switch and outputs response radio waves.
Receives the response radio waves from the electronic key and sends the electronic key ID code to the certification ECU.

Identifies and verifies the ID code from the electronic key, and if verification is OK, sends a key verification OK response to the main body ECU. At the same time, sends a buzzer sounding request signal to the meter ECU.
Move the electronic key away from the engine switch, release the brake pedal, and perform the engine switch ON operation.
→ The main body ECU recognizes engine switch ON.
If the power is OFF, turns the ACC relay ON; if already ACC ON, turns the IG1 and IG2 relays ON. Illuminates the indicator on the engine switch in amber.
After confirming that the power mode has changed, if the steering lock is locked, sends a steering unlock command to the main body ECU.
Receives the steering unlock command and supplies power to the steering lock motor.
After confirming through the ID code box that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, unlocks the steering. Sends unlock completion information to the certification ECU.
After confirming that the steering lock is "unlocked", sends an immobiliser unset command to the ID code box.
After confirming that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, sends an immobiliser unset command to the engine ECU.

INDICATE.TITLE: Engine Stop, Steering Lock and Immobiliser Set Operation Description

ENTRY.PTXT: When the vehicle is stopped, move the shift position to "P" and press the engine switch.
→ The main body ECU recognizes shift position "P", engine switch ON and a vehicle speed of 0 km/h.
The main body ECU controls the ACC relay, IG1 relay and IG2 relay OFF and turns off the indicator on the engine switch.
The certification ECU recognizes power OFF and sends an immobiliser set command to the ID code box.
After confirming that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, sends an immobiliser set command to the engine ECU.
→ The certification ECU recognizes that the door is open. Sends a steering lock command to the main body ECU.
Receives the steering unlock command and supplies power to the steering lock motor.
After confirming through the ID code box that the certification ECU is an authorized ECU, locks the steering. Sends lock completion information to the certification ECU and main body ECU.
